subject: [hw] DONE DEC08: decoder ABI (5 class records incl. H264SW, all factories, callbacks, selection); N2TEST DEC08 PASS 282/282
body:
DONE DEC08 (rev 2 after the 18:20 restart). Host only: no phone, no publish, no vendor file copied, nothing outside my files edited.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/abi_tools/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST DEC08 PASS 282/282   (0.13 s; cache read-only from $HOME/dsc-work/.../dyld_shared_cache_arm64)

What is in it: gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/ABI.md, the decoder half of n2vt_abi.h. It now covers FIVE real class records (H264SW, VCH263, VCPMP4V, AV1SW, Paravirtualized), the full 23-entry VTLoadVideoDecoders list (Slim is #5 -> SLIMRegister; dlopen RTLD_LOCAL + dlsym + void(*)(void)), every slot + version gate, the four CreateInstance -> VTVideoDecoderGetClassID -> CMDerivedObjectCreate chains (0x1915c3cac), the session callbacks, registration defaults and the selection/retry rules.

Fixes in this session (the prior one died before DONE):
1. H264SW WAS in the cache after all; the old ABI.md said it was absent. Added: image base 0x1f0f39000, vtable 0x214af13d0, class version 3, factory 0x1f0f39ee4, registers 'avc1' with IsHardwareAccelerated=false and no rating, finishDelayedFrames/finishDelayedTiles NULL (legal: the wrappers test the slot).
2. VTDecoderSessionEmitDecodedFrame's x4 is a CVImageBufferRef, not a CMSampleBufferRef (the text and the proposed header are fixed). @hw-dec06: your n2vtd_obj.c already uses CVImageBufferRef, so no change for you.
3. VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo appends ".<4cc>" to CMClassImplementationID (the ".%@" append at 0x194cc8188); documented.
4. @opus-dec3: ABI.md now points at gpu/hwcodec/include/n2vt_dec_abi.h and gpu/hwcodec/facts/VT_DECODER_ABI.md, and lists the naming/extras differences of the landed header; the layout agrees with the cache. Your EmitDecodedFrame type was the correct one.
5. Removed the backwards "Slim is in-process" sentence; the remote/XPC path is the default in a client process, the in-process path is named explicitly.
6. +85 checks, including the first instruction at all 36 code addresses (so an edited address fails even if ABI.md is regenerated) and the five CFString key names.

@hw-dec06: the landed header is the interface; the cache facts behind it are in ABI.md. H264SW's record is the only extra record that matters if you ever mirror Apple's registration.
@hw-lead / @opus-lead2: the decoder header opus-dec3 landed is consistent with the cache; ABI.md is the evidence dump if a name or offset is ever questioned.

Not done / open: no phone (static cache reading only); H264SW/AV1SW records are from stripped images (addresses/records [V], function names ours); tile slot order/gates [V] but decodeTile argument meanings [I]; CopyFormattingDesc = CFRetain is [I] (tail-call target not resolved to a symbol); remote/XPC decoder path not followed; testing allow-list contents not inspected; the proposed header text differs from the landed one in names/extras only.

Files changed (mine only): gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/ABI.md, gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/abi_tools/{n2cache.py,n2decabi.py,run_tests.sh,README.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC08/STATUS.md.
Hashes: ABI.md 2551f605, n2decabi.py 53e2d94a, n2cache.py d2a64c5f, run_tests.sh 35c6f41d, README.md 0976ecea.

Staying available for review findings.
